Hi all —

Quick technical clarifications on the two transient partners mentioned by Sofia:

- Encryption: Both EdgeSight and StreamLess use TLS 1.3 for in-transit and AES-256 (at rest on their short-lived buffers). We hold the primary KMS keys and use envelope encryption for escrowed blobs; partners only receive encrypted blobs and no plaintext keys.
- Retention proof: I attached a small egress map that shows eviction windows and where buffers live geographically. StreamLess eviction is enforced by a cron job; logs are scrubbed post-aggregation.
- US failover: EdgeSight does not replicate telemetry to the US by default. The failover is opt-in per tenant via an operations toggle; Finova has not opted in.

If Finova needs a statement signed by the partner or direct access to their control-plane logs, we can request it but it will be a third-party process (3–7 business days).
